readerEvidence.summary: Direct single-pass Astra reading of all 5 original PDF pages; printed pages1–4 plus unnumbered full-page photo. Four independent source tasks12–15 remain whole, with related letter parts and native 40-row stellar and 26-sample telemetry tables. Text layer is unusable for Cyrillic, Greek and signs; original rendered pages adjudicate all wording and data signs. Stellar mu-alpha positive only rows19,22,31,32; mu-delta positive only16,17,22; duplicated rows9/10 and31/32 preserved. Telemetry changes I unit from mW to microW between its two printed column groups; altitude sentinel−1 and final em-dash measurements preserved. Printed fictitious Козлобарана and satirical wording preserved. Entire 11-entry same-year catalogue inspected, no matching Q22S3D official solutions/rubric/supplement; separate theory Q22S3T and main-round psol sources are not falsely paired. No independent checker.
